payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the lower performance on Vikidia-FR compared to Newsela-ES is likely due to differences in content diversity and the impact of ranking metrics on performance evaluation.

claims.text: Vikidia-FR has more diverse content compared to Newsela-ES, which has content from the same domain as Newsela-EN, potentially affecting performance.
Ranking metrics penalize Vikidia-FR more severely due to its limited number of reading levels, leading to lower SRC and KTCC scores when incorrect rankings occur.
The performance increase of 12.3% in RA for Newsela-ES over Vikidia-FR suggests that the ranking model is more effective for Newsela-ES due to its content structure.
